article.story: BOONE, N.C. -- — Tayton Conerway had 16 points in Troy's 69-61 victory over Appalachian State on Thursday night. Conerway also added eight assists for the Trojans (9-4, 2-0 Sun Belt Conference). Thomas Dowd scored 12 points and added six rebounds. Marcus Rigsby Jr. had 12 points and shot 5 for 12, including 2 for 9 from beyond the arc. Myles Tate led the way for the Mountaineers (6-7, 0-2) with 20 points, five assists and four steals. Jalil Beaubrun added 12 points, seven rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
